items.snippet: 이재명 대통령이 14일 청와대 2기 대통령비서실장에 임광현 국세청장(사진)을 임명했다. 강훈식 전 비서실장이 지난달 21일 사의를 표명한 지 23일 만이다. 강 전 실장은 이날 청와대에서 브리핑을 갖고 임 신임 실장에 대해 “국회와 정부를 두루 경험한 만큼 국민의 목소리를 국정에 더 크게 반영하고 당정청 간 협력으로 국정 성과에 속도를 낼 적임자”라고 소개했다. 임 실장은 “대통령을 보좌하는 최고 책임자로서 청와대 업무 전반을 책임지며 민생 성과를 위해 온 힘을 바치겠다”며 “국민의 하루하루가 절박한 만큼 청와대의 하루도 절박해야 할 것”이라고 말했다. 국세청장 출신이 대통령비서실장에 발탁된 것은 처음이다. 충남 홍성 출신인 임 실장은 행정고시 38회로 공직 생활을 시작해 노무현 정부 경제정책비서관실 행정관, 국세청 차장 등을 지냈다. 조사국...

items.title: 브런슨 “조건 충족안된 전작권 전환땐 美대통령에 위험 알릴것”
items.snippet: 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관(한미연합사령관 겸직)이 전시작전통제권 전환에 대해 “조건이 완전히 충족되지 않은 채 실행되는 데 따르는 위험에 대해 분명히 보고할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 이재명 정부가 임기 내 전작권 전환을 위해 속도를 내는 데 대한 반대 목소리를 분명히 한 것으로 풀이된다. 도널드 트럼프 미 행정부 내에서도 전작권 전환이 시기상조라는 목소리가 커지면서 한미동맹 이상 기류가 전작권 전환 문제로 번지는 양상이다. 브런슨 사령관은 13일(현지 시간) 워싱턴의 싱크탱크 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS)가 주최한 대담에서 “내가 지지하는 것은 오직 ‘조건에 기초한’ 전작권 전환”이라면서 이같이 말했다. 그는 “시간도 (전작권 전환의) 하나의 조건이고, 그 결정은 내 몫이 아니다”라면서도 “대통령이 ‘지금 (전작권 전환을) 실행하라’면 따르겠지만...

items.title: 與 견제받은 김지용 “檢개혁 완성하고 싶다”
items.snippet: 김지용 중대범죄수사청장(중수청장) 후보자가 14일 국회 인사청문회에서 “(임명되면) 검찰 개혁을 완성하고 싶다”고 밝혔다. 김 후보자는 이날 열린 청문회에서 ‘왜 중수청장이 되려 하냐’는 질문에 이같이 밝혔다. 김 후보자를 둘러싼 ‘친윤(친윤석열) 논란’에 대해선 “(윤석열 전 대통령과) 가깝지 않으며 개인적인 인연도 없다”고 선을 그었다. 여당과 범여권 강경파들이 김 후보자의 적격성에 대해 문제를 제기하자 적극 해명에 나선 것. 이날 열린 청문회에서 일부 범여권 의원들은 김 후보자가 중수청장에 적합하지 않다며 몰아붙였다. 더불어민주당 윤건영 의원은 과거 무소속 한동훈 의원 수사를 맡았던 정진웅 전 부장검사가 독직폭행 혐의로 기소되는 데 김 후보자가 관여했다며 “비겁한 선택을 한 것”이라고 지적했다. 이에 대해 김 후보자는 “(정 전 부장검사...

items.title: 3주 돌고돌아 하마평 없던 ‘임광현 카드’… 관리형 실장에 무게
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령이 14일 신임 대통령비서실장에 임광현 국세청장을 임명한 것을 두고 청와대와 여당에선 ‘관리형 체제’에 무게를 실었다는 평가가 나온다. 강훈식 전 비서실장이 사의를 표명한 지 3주가 지나도록 후임 인선이 이뤄지지 않은 가운데 관료 출신의 실무형 참모를 이재명 정부 2기 청와대를 이끌 비서실장으로 깜짝 발탁한 것. 국정 기조 변화 대신 정책 실행력을 높여 국면을 돌파하겠다는 뜻이 담겼다는 해석이다. 다만 ‘검찰 개혁’과 후속 내각 인선 등 폭발력 강한 현안이 산적한 가운데 임 실장은 복잡한 당정청 관계를 조율해 나가야 하는 과제를 안게 됐다는 지적이다.● 李 “국회의원 버리고 열 일” 공개 칭찬 청와대는 이 대통령이 2기 국정 성과를 목표로 업무 능력에 초점을 둔 인선을 했다고 밝혔다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “대통령이 능력 중심 인...

items.title: 林 처남, 李 선거법-대북송금 사건 변호… 국힘 “대장동 패밀리 보은 인사 결정판”
items.snippet: 신임 대통령비서실장에 임광현 국세청장이 임명되자 국민의힘은 “‘대장동 패밀리’ 보은 인사의 결정판”이라고 비판하고 나섰다. 임 신임 실장의 배우자가 이경은 주휴스턴 총영사이고, 처남은 이재명 대통령의 대장동 사건과 공직선거법 위반 사건, 위증 교사, 불법 대북송금 사건 등의 변호인을 맡은 이승엽 변호사(사법연수원 27기)인 점을 부각한 것이다. 장동혁 대표는 14일 페이스북에 “임광현(대통령비서실장)의 처남 이승엽 변호사는 이재명(대통령) 변호인”이라며 “대장동, 공직선거법, 위증 교사, 불법 대북송금 변호를 다 맡았다”고 밝혔다. 그러면서 “헌법재판관을 시키려다 여론 반발로 무산되기도 했다”며 “본인 변호사는 가족까지 알뜰하게 챙기는 대통령이다. 국민을 그렇게 좀 챙겨 봤으면 좋겠다”고 덧붙였다. 임 실장의 임명에 이 대통령과 처남 이 변호...

items.title: 499일만에 물러난 강훈식, 서울시장 출마 등 거론
items.snippet: 강훈식 전 대통령비서실장은 14일 “꼭 성공한 정부를 보여 드리고 싶어 국회의원직을 내려놨다고 말씀드렸던 마음 그대로, 오로지 그 일념으로 분투한 499일이었다”고 말했다. 강 전 실장은 지난달 21일 사의를 표명한 지 23일 만인 이날 이재명 정부 첫 비서실장직에서 물러났다. 강 전 실장은 이날 청와대에서 후임인 임광현 신임 비서실장 인선을 발표하며 “대통령직인수위원회도 없이 출범한 정부, 펜 한 자루 없이 시작된 청와대가 대체 불가 대한민국을 꿈꿀 수 있게 되기까지 힘이 돼 준 모든 분에게 진심으로 감사했다”며 마지막 인사를 했다. 이재명 대통령은 X(옛 트위터)에 강 전 실장의 별명인 ‘훈식이형’을 언급하며 “황무지 벌판에서 시작된 국민주권 정부를 조기에 안정시키고 국정을 정상화하는 데 큰 역할을 해줬다”고 말했다. 강 전 실장은 이 대...

items.title: 김지용 “정치검사 1호는 윤석열”… 與강경파 ‘친윤’ 공격에 반박
items.snippet: “정치검사의 공범이다.”(더불어민주당 박주민 의원) “이 정도면 반윤(반윤석열) 아닌가.”(민주당 채현일 의원) 14일 김지용 중대범죄수사청장 후보자에 대한 국회 행정안전위원회 인사청문회에서는 김 후보자의 적격 여부를 둘러싼 여당 의원들의 엇갈린 입장이 고스란히 노출됐다. 민주당뿐만 아니라 범여권 의원들이 김 후보자에 대해 “정치 검찰”이라며 공세 수위를 높여 가자, 다른 민주당 의원이 “정권 눈치를 보지 않는 소신파”라며 엄호하는 상황이 벌어진 것. ‘친윤(친윤석열) 검사’ 논란에 휩싸였던 김 후보자는 이날 ‘정치검사 1호로 누구를 꼽겠느냐’는 질문에 윤석열 전 대통령을 지목하면서 무소속 한동훈 의원도 포함된다고 답했다. 여권 내 임명 반대 여론을 정면으로 돌파하기 위해 적극적으로 입장을 밝힌 것으로 풀이된다.● 野보다 더 세게 때린 與 이...

items.title: 김민석 “신천지 조직적 경선개입 증언 있다”… 친청계 “누가 흘렸는지 밝혀내 퇴출시켜야”
items.snippet: 신천지가 교인 수만 명을 더불어민주당 당원으로 가입시켰다는 의혹과 관련해 당 지도부가 자체 조사 결과를 일부 보고받은 사실이 공개되면서 계파 간 파열음이 커지고 있다. 김민석 대표는 상당한 규모의 집단 가입이 확인됐고 조직적 경선 개입에 대한 증언도 있다고 공개하며 후속 조치를 예고했지만 친청(친정청래)계 최고위원들은 김 대표 면전에서 “누가 무엇을 노리고 흘렸느냐”며 조사 결과 공개와 유출자 색출 등을 요구했다. 14일 최고위원회의에서 친청계 최고위원들은 이달 초 비공개 최고위에서 ‘당원 정비 태스크포스(TF)’ 단장인 박선원 최고위원이 자체 조사 결과를 보고했다는 사실이 알려진 것을 일제히 문제 삼았다. 이성윤 최고위원은 “대표는 취임 후 첫 최고위에서 비공개될 사안이 공개될 경우 지위고하를 막론하고 회의에서 퇴출하겠다고 했다”며 “약속대...

items.title: 국방위 ‘北 지뢰도발 규탄 결의안’ 與주도 채택
items.snippet: 국회 국방위원회가 서부전선 비무장지대(DMZ) 지뢰 폭발 사고와 관련해 이를 북한의 ‘중대 도발’로 규정하고 규탄하는 결의안을 더불어민주당 주도로 채택했다. 국민의힘은 지뢰 도발 진상조사 지연 의혹과 관련해 국회 차원의 진상 규명도 포함해야 한다고 주장했으나 여당이 받아들이지 않자 “껍데기 결의안”이라며 반발했다. 국방위는 14일 전체회의를 열고 ‘군사분계선 이남 지역에서의 북한 지뢰 도발 규탄 결의안’을 의결했다. 결의안에서 여야는 이번 사건을 “정전협정을 정면으로 훼손하고 우리 장병의 생명과 안전을 위협하는 도발로서 결코 용납될 수 없다”고 적시했다. 이에 따라 북한에 진상 규명 책임을 묻고, 책임자 처벌과 재발 방지 대책 마련을 촉구하는 내용도 담겼다. 또한, 정부가 북한에 단호히 대응하고 유엔군사령부와의 긴밀한 공조를 통해 사실관계를...

items.title: “北파병 이후 상황 변해” 美내부서 전작권 조기전환 회의론 확산
items.snippet: 도널드 트럼프 미국 행정부가 한미 외교장관 회담에서 국내 정보라인에 대한 문제를 제기하는 등 한미관계 파장이 커지는 가운데 이재명 정부가 핵심 과제로 추진하고 있는 전시작전통제권 전환을 두고도 한미 간 시각차가 뚜렷해지고 있다. 정부가 올해 말까지 전작권 전환 시기 확정을 추진하는 가운데 미국에서 전작권 조기 전환에 대한 회의론이 확산되고 있는 것. 정부는 ‘톱다운(Top-down)’ 방식을 통해 이재명 정부 임기 내 전작권 전환을 설득하겠다는 방침이지만 자칫 한미 간 마찰이 본격화될 수 있다는 우려가 나온다.● “北 파병으로 상황 변해”… 전작권 전환 조건 달성 기준 달라지나 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관은 13일(현지 시간) 미 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS)가 주최한 대담 내내 조건이 충족되지 않은 전작권 전환에 반대한다고 강조했다. 브런슨...

items.title: [단독]“美, 中제재 의식해 美와 방산협력 중단한 韓업체 문제 삼아”
items.snippet: 중국의 제재 가능성을 우려해 미국 기업과의 협력을 중단한 한국 기업에 대한 미국의 우려가 지난달 한미 외교장관 회담에서 거론된 것으로 알려지면서 미중 전략 경쟁 사이 방산 분야 협력 기업들의 부담이 가속화되고 미국의 문제 제기가 본격화될 수 있다는 우려가 나온다. 외교장관 회담에 앞서 이미 강경화 주미 대사는 석 달 전 귀국 당시 이 문제에 대한 미국의 우려를 국가안전보장회의(NSC)에서 설명했던 것으로 전해졌다. 14일 정부 고위 소식통에 따르면 미국은 특정 한국 기업이 중국과의 사업 관계나 추가 제재 리스크 등을 고려해 특정 미국 방산 기업과의 협력을 주저한 점을 문제 삼았다고 한다. 미중 전략 경쟁이 방산 분야 대외 협력에 직접적인 영향을 미친 것으로 밝혀진 사례는 처음이다. 중국은 2024년 대만에 대한 미국의 무기 판매를 이유로 해당...

items.title: 강선우, 김경에 “원하는 공천 면접 질문, 김병기에 보내라” 말해
items.snippet: 2022년 제8회 지방선거 시의원 공천 대가로 1억원을 받은 혐의로 기소된 무소속 강선우(서울 강서갑) 의원이 14일 서울중앙지법 형사1단독 이춘근 부장판사 심리로 열린 1심에서 징역 2년 6개월을 선고받고 법정 구속됐다. 지난달 22일 보석으로 풀려난 지 3주 만에 다시 구속된 것이다. 이 부장판사는 판결문에 강 의원이 자기에게 돈을 준 김경(전 서울시의원)씨에게 “공천 면접에서 받고 싶은 질문을 김병기 의원에게 미리 보내라”고 했다고 적시했다. 김병기 의원은 당시 더불어민주당 서울시당 공천관리위원회 간사였다. 강 의원의 공천 비위 사건은 강 의원이 김씨 문제를 김 의원과 상의하는 녹음 파일이 공개되면서 시작됐다.

items.title: “딸 위험” 엄마 경고 무시한 경찰… 아빠·4세 아이 결국 숨진채 발견
items.snippet: 아내와 양육권 분쟁을 벌이던 40대 남성이 제주에서 네 살 딸과 함께 숨진 채 발견됐다. 아내는 열흘 전 경찰에 “딸이 위험하다”고 알렸지만 경찰은 정식 사건으로 접수하지 않고 단순 민원으로 처리했다. 14일 제주경찰청 등에 따르면, 지난 12일 오후 6시 8분쯤 제주 서귀포시 표선면의 한 공영 주차장에 주차된 렌터카 안에서 40대 A씨와 네 살 딸이 숨진 채 발견됐다. 차 안에서는 스스로 목숨을 끊은 흔적이 나왔다.

items.snippet: 14일 울산 울주군 온산읍의 한 화학제품 제조업체에서 불이 나 시커먼 연기가 치솟고 있다. 소방대원들이 물을 뿌리며 불길을 잡고 있다. 이날 오전 9시 41분쯤 발생한 불은 약 4시간 만에 꺼졌다. 저장 탱크 33기 중 7기가 불탔다. 인명 피해는 없었으나 주변 공장 작업자 등 7000여 명이 대피했다. 당시 업체에서는 인화성 물질인 톨루엔을 드럼통에 옮기는 작업을 하고 있었다고 한다.

items.title: “휴직한 김대리 올해 의대 갔대”
items.snippet: 37세 김모씨는 재작년 회사를 휴직하고 1년간 수능을 준비했다. 서울대 공대를 졸업하고 안정적인 공기업에 취직했지만, 오르지 않는 연봉에 더는 미래가 보이지 않자 의대에 가기로 마음먹은 것이다. 김씨는 결국 작년 초 졸업한 지 17년 만에 지방 한 사립대 의대에 들어갔다. 그는 “요즘 공부 잘하는 사람들이 다 의대를 가고 싶어 하는데, 나도 공부를 잘했었으니까 한 번 도전해보자는 생각이 들었다”며 “직장 다니다가 온 동기가 10명은 넘는 것 같다”고 했다.

items.title: 60대 일자리 20만개 늘 때, 20대는 5만개 줄었다
items.snippet: 3년 전 서울의 한 명문대를 졸업한 A(27)씨는 그동안 두 차례 기업 인턴을 거치고 프리랜서로도 일하며 경험을 쌓았다. 하지만 아직까지 정규직 일자리를 구하지 못했다고 한다. 그는 “채용 사이트를 보면 나 같은 ‘신입’ 자리는 거의 없고 경력직 공고가 대부분”이라며 “이제는 인턴 자리도 구하기 어려워지고 있다”고 했다.

items.title: 국내 첫 자연번식한 레서판다 마루와 마롱이
items.snippet: 14일 경기 과천시 서울대공원에서 자연 번식에 성공한 레서판다 쌍둥이 남매 ‘마루’와 ‘마롱’이 관람객들을 바라보고 있다. 이들 남매가 일반에 공개된 건 이날이 처음이다. 멸종 위기 동물인 레서판다는 암컷의 가임 기간이 1년에 2~3일에 불과해 자연 번식이 까다로운 것으로 알려졌다. 서울대공원은 2023년 해외에서 아빠 ‘라비’와 엄마 ‘리안’을 들여와 3년 만인 지난 6월 19일 국내 최초로 자연 번식에 성공했다.

items.title: Thousands of supermarket fridges still exposed after cyberattack
items.snippet: No group has claimed the attack, and experts warn thousands of similarly exposed devices remain online as a separate incident disrupts Dutch grocer Albert Heijn.

items.title: [신문은 선생님] [생활 속 경제] 기후 위기가 만든 새로운 바닷길… 유럽 가는 시간 30% 줄여준대요
items.snippet: Q. 지난 11일 북극 항로를 시험 운항한 컨테이너선이 부산으로 돌아왔다는 뉴스를 보았어요. 북극 항로가 무엇이고, 이 길이 열리면 어떤 점이 좋을까요? 북극 항로는 북극해를 가로질러 아시아와 유럽을 잇는 가장 짧은 뱃길입니다. 아시아에서 수에즈 운하를 거쳐 유럽으로 향하는 길은 약 2만㎞인데, 북극 항로의 길이는 약 1만 3000㎞에 불과해요. 우리가 흔히 보는 평면형 세계지도에서는 북극이 가장자리에 놓여 있어 이 길이 잘 보이지 않아요. 하지만 둥근 지구본을 위에서 내려다보면 북극해를 가로질러 두 대륙을 잇는 길이 보이죠.

items.title: 전립선암 제거 ‘앞’ 아닌 ‘뒤’로 했더니… 후유증 확 줄어
items.snippet: 초고령사회를 맞아 남성암 1위 전립선암, 요즘 전립선암 제거 수술은 거의 모두 로봇 수술로 한다. 기존에 배를 열고 하는 수술보다 정교한 로봇 손과 팔로 전립선을 세밀하게 제거할 수 있기 때문이다. 하지만 그래도 일부에서 수술 후 배뇨 장애가 발생하여 고생을 한다. 그런 배경 속에서 환자에게 수술 후 배뇨 기능을 잘 유지할 수 있도록 하는 ‘새로운’ 수술법이 주목받고 있다. 전립선 뒤쪽으로 접근해 암을 제거하는 이른바 후방 접근 로봇 전립선절제술이다. 가천대 길병원 비뇨의학과 김태범 교수팀은 이 수술을 집중적으로 시행하며 경험을 축적해 왔다. 올해 9월 기준으로 후방 접근 수술이 1000례에 육박한다. 이 수술을 받은 환자의 배뇨 기능 회복을 분석한 연구 2편을 길병원 박일우 교수 등이 최근 이탈리아에서 열린 유럽비뇨의학회 로봇비뇨기수술분과...

items.title: 65세 실외, 79세 실내… 나이 따라 낙상 장소 달라
items.snippet: 75세 김모씨는 집 근처 공원을 걷다가 산책로의 작은 턱에 발이 걸려 넘어졌다. 오른쪽 고관절이 골절돼 수술을 받고 병원에 입원하는 신세가 됐다. 하루 종일 누워 있는 시간이 많다 보니 근육이 확 줄었다. 부쩍 노쇠된 몸 상태가 됐다. 요즘 정형외과 병원에 가면 흔히 볼 수 있는 노년기 낙상 모습이다. 젊어서 넘어지는 것은 잠깐의 사고로 끝나지만, 노년기에 넘어지면 골절과 입원, 근육 감소, 보행 장애, 사회적 고립으로 이어진다. 심하면 평생 지켜온 독립적인 생활을 잃고 요양시설에 들어가야 하는 상황도 생긴다. 그래서 노년에 넘어지면 인생도 무너진다는 말이 나온다.

items.title: [Dr.이은봉의 의학 연구 다이제스트] 대장 용종 제거후 추가 내시경 5년뒤 해도 돼
items.snippet: 대장암은 주로 폴립(용종)이란 작은 종양으로 시작하기에 건강검진을 통해 조기에 폴립을 찾아내고 제거하면 대장암 발생을 예방할 수 있다. 폴립 크기가 10㎜ 이상이거나, 개수가 3개 이상이거나, 낮게 깔리는 융모 형태로 자란 경우 등에서는 향후 대장암으로 발생할 가능성이 높기 때문에, 폴립 제거 후 3년 후 대장내시경 검사를 다시 받도록 추천한다. 최근 노르웨이와 스페인 연구팀은 폴립 제거 후 적절한 대장경 검사 시기가 언제인지를 조사하고, 그 결과를 세계 최고의 학술지 뉴잉글랜드 의학저널(NEJM)에 발표했다.

items.title: 잘 먹고 많이 움직이면 1년內 입원 경험 11%↓
items.snippet: 식사의 질이 높고 신체활동도 충분한 성인은 두 가지 모두 부족한 성인보다 최근 1년간 입원 경험이 있을 가능성이 11% 낮은 것으로 나타났다. 서울대병원 가정의학과 박민선 교수팀은 국민건강영양조사(2014~2021년) 자료를 활용해 성인 3만7059명의 식사의 질·신체활동과 입원 경험의 연관성을 분석했다. 연구팀은 식사의 질을 한국인 식생활평가지수(KHEI)로 평가해 중앙값을 기준으로 높음·낮음으로 나눴다. 신체활동은 걷기를 포함한 여가 시간 활동량이 주 150분(약간 숨이 찰 정도의 활동) 이상이면 활동군, 미만이면 비활동군으로 구분했다. 식사 질 높고 낮음, 활동량 많고 적음에 따라 4개 조합으로 나누고, 최근 1년간 입원 경험과 최근 2주간 외래 방문 경험을 비교했다.

items.title: [신문은 선생님] [뉴스 속의 한국사] 왕의 집무실 겸 생활공간… 샹들리에·카펫도 갖췄대요
items.snippet: 국가유산청 궁능유적본부가 20일부터 31일까지(일·월요일 제외) 하루 두 차례 창덕궁 희정당(熙政堂)과 대조전(大造殿)을 개방하는 행사를 한다고 밝혔어요. 이 두 건물은 왕과 왕비의 생활·집무 공간이었어요. 오늘은 희정당이라는 독특한 궁궐 건물에 대해 이야기하고자 합니다. 지난 7~11일 궁중문화축전을 맞아 공예 전시와 함께 개방돼 많은 사람이 찾았던 곳이기도 한데, ‘만약 조선 왕조가 멸망하지 않고 지속됐더라면 모든 궁궐이 이처럼 변모했을 것’이라는 걸 느낄 수 있는 장소입니다.

items.title: Mont Blanc rises by almost two metres, now standing at 4,807.47 metres
items.snippet: An altitude that "is close to the historical value" measured at the end of the 19th century, but still not enough to draw conclusions about the effects of global warming.

items.title: 강인숙·강은교 ‘자랑스러운 경기인’
items.snippet: 경기여자고등학교 총동창회 경운회(회장 이숭리)는 제33회 ‘자랑스러운 경기인’ 수상자로 강인숙 영인문학관 관장과 강은교 시인을 선정했다고 14일 밝혔다. 영인문학관 설립자인 강 관장은 지난 25년간 문인들의 육필 원고와 편지, 초상화, 서화 등을 모아 보존하는 등 문학 유산의 전승과 대중화에 기여해왔다. 강 시인은 60년 세월 동안 치열한 사유와 맑고 깊은 언어로 한국 문학을 풍요롭게 하고 현대시의 지평을 넓혀왔다. 17일 개교 118주년 기념식에서 시상한다.

items.title: 부모 마음, 낳아 보니 깨달아… 세 딸 목소리로 담은 “엄마·아빠 감사해요”
items.snippet: “우리는 자전거를 타고 동네를 돌아다니면서 놉니다.” 마이크 앞에 선 두 여자아이가 번갈아 가족의 일상을 소개한다. 동네 사람들이 반갑게 인사하고, 강아지들도 친구가 돼준다는 이야기와 함께 화면에는 가족이 즐겁게 어울리는 모습이 이어진다. 영상은 “하루하루가 너무 즐겁습니다. 엄마 아빠, 태어나게 해줘서 고맙습니다”라는 인사로 끝난다. 아이들의 감사 인사에는 이 영상을 만든 아빠 김신의(37)씨가 양가 부모님께 전하고 싶은 마음도 담겨 있다.

items.title: 인구 정책은 ‘긴 호흡’ 필요… 출생·청년·가족·고령 사회 모두 연계해야
items.snippet: 대한민국의 오늘을 만든 가장 강력한 자원은 무엇이었을까. 자본도 천연자원도 부족하던 우리나라가 전쟁의 폐허를 딛고 세계 10위권 경제 대국으로 성장할 수 있었던 힘은 결국 ‘사람’이었다. 양질의 교육을 받은 인재들이 기업을 일구고, 새로운 시장을 개척해 글로벌 성공 신화를 만들었다. 도전 정신을 가진 한국인의 DNA는 성장의 원동력이자 가장 중요한 자원이었다. 그러나 이제 그 토대가 근본부터 흔들리고 있다.

items.title: Black Hawk down: Trump's trade war pauses Canadian helicopter deal
items.snippet: The Carney government quietly suspended plans to purchase 16 Black Hawk helicopters for Canada's special forces amid escalating tensions with Washington. The decision reflects Ottawa's growing reluctance to buy American military equipment, even as commanders seek urgently needed capabilities. Critics warn short-term political calculations could undermine long-term military readiness.

items.title: Why Zelenskyy's claims that Ukraine drone attack halted Russian bot traffic don't hold up
items.snippet: When Ukrainian drones hit three data centres owned by Russian technology and AI company Yandex this weekend, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy initially said it resulted in a sudden drop in pro-Russia bot activity on social media. items.title: Single anyons and anyon binding in a quantum Hall dot
items.abstract: Anyons are particles with quantized fractional statistics. In theory, a single anyon can be stabilized as a localized fractional charge within the bulk of a topologically ordered two-dimensional insulator. However, experiments to date have focused on probing anyons in structures in which many anyonic excitations coexist and interact. Here, we demonstrate the trapping of a single anyon in a device consisting of a graphene-based quantum point contact with an embedded tunable quantum Hall dot. Benchmarking our device at v = 1, we demonstrate backscattering between Fermi liquid edge states mediated by the whole-electron Coulomb blockade of the dot. The cleanliness and control available in our device allow depletion of the dot to the last quasihole, and we observe spin blockade for transitions to the opposite-spin Landau level. items.snippet: 13일 인천 남동구의 한 상가 푸드코트에서 50대 남성이 흉기를 휘둘러 시민 8명이 다쳤다. 이 중 1명은 심정지 상태로 병원에 이송됐다. 이 남성은 양손에 흉기를 묶은 채 식사 중이던 시민들을 공격했다. 남성의 가방에서는 망치와 가위, 약물 등이 발견됐다. 이 남성은 과거 살인미수 혐의로 복역했으며 전자발찌를 찬 상태에서 범행을 저질렀다. 범행 전 보호관찰관과 면담한 뒤 함께 점심을 먹은 사실도 확인됐다. 남성은 지난달에도 흉기를 소지한 혐의로 경찰에 입건됐던 것으로 밝혀졌다.

Direct growth of crystalline spinel GaON films: A wide-bandgap mixed-anion semiconductor
items.abstract: Mixed-anion semiconductors offer opportunities for bandgap engineering beyond conventional multication alloys, but competing phases and disorder complicate their synthesis and the identification of their electronic properties. Gallium oxynitride (GaON) could connect the technologically important GaN and Ga2O3 systems, yet establishing a clear relation between its crystal structure, composition and bandgap remains challenging. Here we report the direct growth of crystalline spinel gamma-GaON films by nitrogen-plasma-assisted pulsed-laser deposition. Varying the nitrogen and oxygen supply yields monoclinic beta-Ga2O3, predominantly disordered films and crystalline spinel GaON. Complementary diffraction, atomic-resolution microscopy and elemental analysis establish the spinel structure and nitrogen incorporation. items.title: Coherent Phonon Generation from Prethermal Carrier Populations in a Semiconductor
items.abstract: Ultrafast laser excitation of carriers in semiconductors often results in the creation of fully symmetric coherent optical phonons, typically understood in terms of a thermalized transient carrier population. We test this understanding with systematic measurements and first-principles calculations of the photon-energy dependence of ultrafast-laser-driven coherent phonon generation in tellurium, using excitation wavelengths around the electronic band gap. We observe that, contrary to the expectations of models assuming a thermalized carrier population, the coherent amplitude of the fully symmetric $A_1$ mode changes only weakly when tuning wavelength across the band gap. The measured spectral dependence is instead reproduced by a transition-resolved prethermal force weighted by optical matrix elements and band- and momentum-dependent $A_1$ deformation potentials. items.title: Tellurium trioxide as an n-type wide-gap semiconductor with ultrahigh work functions from first principles
items.abstract: The exploration of next-generation wide-gap semiconductors with extreme work functions is highly desirable for the continued advancement of electronic and optoelectronic devices. By using first principles calculations, we show that \b{eta}-TeO3, with a wide band gap exceeding 3 eV, emerges as a promising n-type semiconductor exhibiting ultrahigh work functions of up to ~8 eV. Intentionally or unintentionally incorporated interstitial H, Li, Na, Cu, Mg, and Zn impurities and substitutional F impurities are identified as shallow donors, whereas O vacancies act as minor carrier-compensating defects that locally trap electrons at neighbouring Te sites. The work function is evaluated across a series of low-index nonpolar surfaces. items.title: Thermal stability and structural ordering of thick Co$_2$MnAl films grown on MgO and Si substrates
items.abstract: While most studies on Co$2$MnAl (CMA) focus on the ultrathin regime for spintronic junctions, applications scaling with magnetic volume--such as Anomalous Nernst Effect (ANE) energy harvesters, integrated power inductors, and magnetic MEMS--require significantly thicker films. In this work, 750 nm thick CMA films were grown on MgO (001) and Si substrates to establish a roadmap for their thermal integration. Structural analysis reveals that B2 ordering is optimized on MgO at 600 $^\circ$C, which is important for functional devices. In contrast, samples on Si substrates exhibit a disorder transition toward the A2 phase, closely linked to diffusion-driven degradation processes. items.title: ARES: a plane-wave density-functional-theory code in Rust
items.abstract: ARES (Ab initio atomic mateRial modEling Software at JLU) is a plane-wave density-functional-theory (DFT) code written entirely in Rust as a layered 22-crate workspace. It supports norm-conserving pseudopotentials and the projector augmented-wave (PAW) method with the local-density approximation (LDA) and Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) functionals, Γ-only and explicit k-point sampling, smearing and mixing, forces, stress, relaxation, band structures, densities of states (DOS) and dispersion corrections; execution is serial or MPI-distributed over k-point pools, band groups and plane-wave rows. The code's distinguishing engineering choice is its validation apparatus. items.title: Theory of deeply subwavelength electromagnetic structuring of semiconductors due to thermal-ionization instability
items.abstract: We develop a theory of ionization-assisted instability that governs the reflection of intense electromagnetic pulses from a semiconductor surface. Local overheating of the material increases the free-carrier density and conductivity, which in turn enhances the absorption of the incident radiation and further amplifies local heating and avalanche ionization. At high pump repetition rates, the overheating accumulates from pulse to pulse, leading to a gradual rise of the local material temperature and free carrier density - a positive feedback loop that drives thermal runaway. However, this effect competes with diffraction of the pump field on the emerging perturbation of the dielectric permittivity or on the surface relief, which reduces the local electric field amplitude in the overheated regions, thus providing negative feedback. items.title: Mixed Precision Scaling Laws for Quantized Pretraining
items.abstract: Since scaling laws were introduced for modern LLMs (Kaplan et al., 2020), several works have extended them to account for quantization, tracking the emerging low-precision data types supported on AI accelerators. We develop a more accurate scaling law for quantized pretraining with mixed precision across the forward and backward passes, grounded in optimization theory and validated empirically. Our formulation separates the effects of quantization on model capacity and on optimization efficiency, and explicitly models the persistent optimization error from forward and backward quantization identified through convergence analysis. To select the regimes for fitting and evaluating our law, we first decompose existing 4-bit training recipes into their forward and backward components, isolating those that most affect loss. items.title: First-Principles Calculations of the Electron-Hole-Pair Creation Energy in Semiconductors and Dielectrics
items.abstract: We present first-principles calculations of the electron-hole-pair creation energy in semiconductors and dielectrics, focusing in particular on AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2. We have employed density functional theory (DFT) to calculate the band structure, density-functional perturbation theory to obtain the phonon dispersion, and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT) to calculate the electron energy loss function (via the dielectric function). We performed full-band Monte Carlo simulations of electron thermalization for energies up to ~100 eV and calculated the average energy required to excite an electron-hole pair. We calculated pair-creation energies of approximately 12.2, 6.5, 7.3, 3.10, and 16.7 eV/pair for AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2, respectively. items.title: Decoupling Trap States in Amorphous Oxide Semiconductor Transistor Using a Conductive-Semiconducting-Conductive MOS Structure
items.abstract: We propose a novel amorphous oxide semiconductor (AOS)-based conductive-semiconducting-conductive (CSC) MOS test structure to effectively sense, discriminate, and analyze distinct trap-induced conductance losses in AOS transistors. In conventional test structures, non-ideal metal-AOS contacts convolute the conductance loss generated by various trap states. The CSC architecture mitigates these contact-related artifacts, enabling the decoupling of interface states and shallow states. Furthermore, the contributions from leakage, series resistance, and device-geometry effects are identified and calibrated. Our results yield bias-resolved trap profiles and reveal three distinct regimes: (1) In the depletion region, interface states dominate the conductance loss. items.title: Toward Partitioned Reference Readout for Four-Level IGZO Memory: Device Statistics, Confusion Matrices, and INT4 Error Propagation
items.abstract: Four-level indium-gallium-zinc oxide (IGZO) 2T0C memory needs reliable state formation, sensing references, and a path from cell errors to digital weights. We analyze 107 measured DC transfer curves from 37 isolated IGZO transistors (W/L = 3/0.5 micrometers). Four gate-bias operating points inferred from the first sweep are evaluated on later sweeps of 35 devices. Device-resolved operating points reduce second-sweep across-device current standard deviation by 49.4-52.4%, yet retaining initial thresholds increases misclassified points from 37/140 to 55/140. Leave-one-device-out reference estimation gives 0/140 on the second sweep; freezing second-sweep thresholds yields 6/140 on the third. Sampling eight reference transistors on the third sweep gives a mean held-out error fraction of 0.15% over 2,000 selections, versus 4.33% with frozen thresholds on matched held-out devices. The refractive index is one of the crucial parameters that affect the interaction of light with matter. Although the refractive index can be measured experimentally, its estimation via computational means provide the advantage of not requiring costly instrumentation, trained researchers and could avoid potential laboratory-based uncertainties. items.title: Stateless Stochastic Computing for Generative AI on Superconducting Logic: A Model-Hardware Co-Design
items.abstract: Thermodynamic computing lets stochastic physical dynamics carry out a computation and reads out the result as a time average. Recently, thermodynamic computing has been demonstrated on several hardware platforms, including digital CMOS circuits based on stochastic computing. Superconducting single-flux-quantum (SFQ) logic offers very high clock rates and very low switching energy, but it heavily penalizes state, memory, fan-out, and feedback, i.e., exactly the per-neuron accumulators on which such designs rely. We therefore realize thermodynamic computing in SFQ logic through a co-design of a generative model and its circuit in which the datapath holds no state at all. items.abstract: LLM agents now write their own schematic and layout generators, run EDA tools, read the results, and fix the design. This "vibe tapeout" is becoming practical for analog circuits as well. This paper measures how far it has come in two settings. (A) On an open PDK (SKY130), a cloud LLM agent designed an 11-bit, 5.12-MS/s SAR ADC from its specification. The agents produced DRC- and LVS-clean macros and met the specification after parasitic extraction (PEX). In particular, under the condition in which the agent received a sanitized reference design derived from our 65-nm design (vibe porting), it produced the best layout in the shortest time. Its area was 1/1.6 to 1/2.8 of that of the conditions without a reference. This condition reached signoff without human intervention. items.title: Localized Joule heating and carbonization process optimization of 3D printed polymer structures for lab-on-CMOS applications
items.abstract: Use of carbon electrodes integrated with CMOS technology has great promise for lab-on-chip, biomedical, environmental, and industrial applications. One method of developing carbon electrodes is to 3D print polymer nanostructures on a CMOS chip, and use a thermal annealing process to pyrolyze them into carbon at high temperature, approximately 950 °C. Such high temperature is detrimental to the CMOS sensor circuits, causing severe degradation. We present a novel solution of localized Joule heating of these polymer nanostructures to achieve complete carbonization of the electrodes. Both analytical and COMSOL simulations guided the experiments to characterize the carbonization process conditions. Partial carbonization was achieved at 500-600 °C of global temperature, and complete carbonization was achieved by localized Joule heating. items.title: TileCas: Cascading Kernel Development Across Programming Abstractions
items.abstract: Programming abstractions have traditionally been designed for humans, but code generation is increasingly performed by models and autonomous agents. We investigate abstractions for machine-driven programming through GPU and AI-accelerator kernel generation. High-level domain-specific languages (DSLs) simplify search by delegating implementation details to compilers, while lower-level representations provide finer-grained control at the cost of a larger and more complex search space. In this paper, we present TileCas, a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels. Rather than committing to a single representation, TileCas allows an agent to transfer and refine candidates across levels through Cross-Level Diagnosis, which maps correctness and performance feedback to actionable controls at different abstraction level...

items.title: Enhancing Quasi-Two-Dimensional Electronic Structure in Bi2O2Se via Chlorine Substitution
items.abstract: Bismuth oxyselenide (Bi2O2Se) has emerged as a leading semiconductor candidate for next-generation electronics and quantum phenomena research. However, its strong ionic interlayer bonding of Se layers fundamentally restricts the full potential of this otherwise promising quasi-two-dimensional (2D) material. In this work, we demonstrate chlorine substitution as an effective strategy to introduce van der Waals gaps and modify the electronic structure of the system. Through comprehensive transport and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements on Bi6O6Se2Cl2 single crystal, an optimal Cl-doping compound, we show that the key electronic features, including indirect band gap, high electron mobility, and carrier effective mass, are well preserved, while the 2D character of the system is sufficiently enhanced. AI Acceleration of Muon Collider R&D: A Report from the AI4MuC Workshop
items.abstract: A Muon Collider is one of the most attractive routes to multi-TeV lepton collisions, but it requires the accelerator and detector communities to solve a tightly coupled set of problems that have no close precedent in an operating collider. Muons must be produced, captured, cooled, accelerated, and collided before they decay. The detector must then extract clean physics from an environment dominated by decay products from the beamline. Artificial intelligence is not a substitute for accelerator physics, detector design, or engineering validation. It is, however, unusually well matched to several of the central obstacles: high-dimensional design spaces, expensive simulations, coupled subsystem trade-offs, and workflows that are currently too slow or too fragile to support broad design exploration. items.title: Revealing New Leakage Paths in GAAFETs using Predictive First-Principles Simulations
items.abstract: Gate-All-Around Field-Effect Transistors (GAAFETs) are emerging as successors to Fin Field-Effect Transistors (FinFETs) and are central to continued scaling at advanced semiconductor nodes. Despite their improved electrostatic control, recent measurements show that the drain current in GAAFETs deviates strongly from thermionic behavior at negative gate voltages, increasing as the gate voltage becomes more negative. This leakage has been attributed to direct gate-drain tunneling through the high-$k$ dielectric, enhanced by drain-induced dielectric barrier lowering (DIDBL). Here, we use predictive, charge-self-consistent Non-Equilibrium Green Function (NEGF) simulations based on the Contact Block Reduction (CBR) method to spatially resolve this leakage pathway in GAAFETs. items.title: DFIT: A Framework for Building Instrumentation Tools Across Heterogeneous Dataflow Accelerators
items.abstract: Emerging dataflow accelerators offer exceptional energy efficiency and throughput for machine learning workloads, yet remain largely opaque to developers for performance analysis. Unlike CPUs and GPUs, where instrumentation frameworks enable fine-grained introspection, dataflow hardware exposes little information. This lack of transparency limits the ability of compiler engineers, system designers, and application developers to analyze, tune, or debug accelerator behavior. In this paper, we introduce DFIT (DataFlow Accelerator Instrumentation Tool), an instrumentation framework designed specifically for dataflow architectures. DFIT directly instruments operations, regions, and compiler transformations at the graph IR and backend-lowering stages using semantic program representation. items.title: Predicting Nanofabrication Variance: A Conditional Diffusion Model
items.abstract: Micro- and nanostructures fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling invariably deviate from input designs due to systematic and stochastic effects such as ablation-rate fluctuations, and redeposition. As such, nominally identical iterations of a given process yield a distribution of non-identical fabrication outcomes, leading to variations in the physical (optical, mechanical) properties of fabricated structures. Existing models of the milling process typically predict a single deterministic fabrication result, neglecting this variability. Here we present a conditional diffusion model that learns the statistical distribution of process outcomes conditioned on input design, enabling it to predict a realistic distribution of possible output sample structures. items.title: Orbital transfer reveals material-selective structure in Rydberg excitons
items.abstract: Rydberg excitons in atomically thin semiconductors offer a sensitive view of dielectric screening and electronic structure. As their spectra become increasingly well resolved, a central question is how much material information an effective Hamiltonian can predict beyond the states used to determine it. Using the 1s, 2p and 2s levels to determine a scalar Rytova-Keldysh Hamiltonian, we test its transfer to the excluded 3p state. The transfer deviations have opposite signs: the observed 3p lies 7.38 meV below the prediction in MoSe2 and 5.58 meV above it in WS2; the opposite signs persist across the complete reported +/-2-sigma peak-error boxes. items.title: Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
items.abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. items.title: Nonlocal Josephson coupling and current redistribution in a large-area graphene multiterminal Josephson junction
items.abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) extend conventional two-terminal Josephson physics to devices defined by multiple superconducting phases, where rich phenomena have been predicted. However, in conventional MTJJs, superconducting transport is often dominated by local coupling between neighboring leads, obscuring physics that goes beyond simple connectivity. Here, we realize a multiterminal Josephson network in a graphene Hall bar geometry with micron-scale dimensions, enabling substantial nonlocal coupling between distant terminals. Our key observation is a pronounced negative differential longitudinal resistance (NDLR) in the four-probe response near switching currents, while no such feature appears in two-terminal measurements. items.title: An all-transistor physical-learning transformer can be trained to perform in-context learning
items.abstract: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. items.abstract: Step-index few-mode fibers (FMFs) provide a compact passive platform for high-speed photonic information processing by exploiting modal dispersion to map temporal inputs into spatiotemporal representations with short-term memory. Here, we extend the computational capability of such architectures towards solving nonlinear tasks by introducing an optical nonlinearity at the output of the dispersive medium. The FMF output is processed through parallel direct and nonlinear branches, with the latter implemented using a nonlinear semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA). items.title: Effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of CrSBr
items.abstract: We present a systematic study of the effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of the van der Waals layered semiconductor CrSBr. Our study shows that even at substitution level of $x=56\%$ the $\mathrm{CrSBr_{1-x}Cl_{x}}$ material exhibits qualitatively the same clear magneto-optical coupling that was observed in pure CrSBr crystals. The values of the relevant parameters are shown to vary smoothly across different substitution levels, thus offering promising tunability for this family of 2D magnetic materials.

items.title: Band Tail States: Speed Bump or End of the Road for Two-Dimensional Semiconductors?
items.abstract: We propose that the path to realizing the full potential of two-dimensional (2D) electronics lies in understanding and mastering their energy band tail states (BTS). Unlike silicon, which benefits from sharp band edges (Urbach energy $E_\rm U$ ~ 10 meV), today's monolayer 2D semiconductors have rough band edges ($E_\rm U$ ~ 100 meV) caused by spatial potential inhomogeneity. Comparing a physics-based electrical model to experiments, we demonstrate that BTS cause reduced effective mobility and "slow" transistor turn-on with excessive gate voltage in monolayer 2D transistors, which sets a fundamental limit for their energy-efficient operation. We also show that BTS effects in 2D transistors could be mitigated with higher gate capacitance, with strain engineering, and by using bilayer instead of monolayer 2D channels, as long as $E_\rm U$ is reduced below ~ 50 meV. items.abstract: Optically exciting a typical low-dimensional semiconductor produces a nodeless \(s\)-type exciton as its lowest-energy bound state. We trace this behaviour to a gauge-invariant combination of exciton phase differences and Bloch-overlap phases that can reduce the Coulomb energy. items.title: Squeezed light from a semiconductor amplifier
items.abstract: The possibility of generating light in a squeezed quantum state during saturated light amplification in a semiconductor amplifier is theoretically analyzed. Due to four-wave mixing process during amplification, weak components of the spontaneous emission of the medium with symmetric frequency shifts relative to the strong amplified wave acquire the quantum properties of two-mode squeezed light. The squeezing of quadrature components occurs in the range of frequency shifts of several GHz ($\sim$ the inverse relaxation time of the charge carrier density) and can reach 10 dB or more under optimal conditions. The formation of a two-mode squeezing phase facilitates the observation of the squeezing effect, in which a strong wave, playing the role of a local wave, exhibits quadrature noise suppression without additional homodyne detection.

items.title: Two-exciton bound states in the Merrifield exciton model
items.abstract: Understanding the formation and dynamics of two-exciton bound states (BSs) is crucial for harnessing multi-exciton phenomena and designing next-generation organic semiconductor materials. While various mechanisms such as intermolecular exciton-exciton interactions or multi-level intramolecular configurations can generate these BSs, a fundamental understanding of their underlying lattice dynamics remains a key challenge. Within this context, the Merrifield exciton model stands out as a premier framework for capturing the intricate quantum mixing between single-site doubly-excited states and two-particle scattering continuum. In this work, by constructing a set of exact two-exciton Bloch states and applying a plane-wave ansatz to treat the resulting inhomogeneous tridiagonal matrices, we provide a complete, rigorous solution to the two-exciton problem in a finite-size Merrifield chain. We...

items.title: Sparse qubit operation in a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array
items.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires increasing the qubit count while maintaining high performance and connectivity. Semiconductor qubits have demonstrated high-fidelity operation, but growing the system size at sufficient connectivity remains challenging, such that scaling mainly occurred in one spatial direction to preserve access for control lines in the other. Here, we realise an approach that relaxes the requirements on fabrication and demonstrate a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array, defined by a shared barrier gate and individual plunger gates. The quantum dots are tuned through coherent spin shuttling over distances up to 5.2um into a sparse configuration of 10 simultaneously operated qubits, leaving space for shuttling connections. We reduce crosstalk by 42$\times$ in this separated regime, enabling high-fidelity simultaneous single-qubit control, while control-Z operations can...

items.title: CacheFit: The Rising Cost of Cache Replacement and Constraint-Driven Redesign of Last-Level Cache Replacement Policies
items.abstract: The latency, power, and area costs of LLC replacement remain poorly explored not because simulators cannot be instrumented--event counters feeding a power model are routine--but because no cost model takes a replacement policy as input. CACTI and McPAT price regular structures, a cache or a core, not the small, oddly shaped arrays and dependent logic a policy is made of, and no event count reveals a victim-selection path's logic depth. Without a model, cost has never been an objective a policy search could optimize. In practice, a policy is first selected in simulation for its IPC, and its cost is reduced later in RTL, after the algorithm is fixed. Cost thus enters the design too late to shape it. This paper asks what happens when cost is present from the start. We build CacheFit, the first policy-design loop for LLC replacement with circuit-level cost inside the search objective. CacheF...

items.title: 2d-fet-bench: from spatial reasoning to fet design on flakes
items.abstract: Field-effect transistor (FET) layouts on exfoliated two-dimensional flakes are typically drawn by hand for each flake, placing contacts and gates to match its position and outline in optical micrographs. To our knowledge, no executable benchmark tests whether language-model agents can perform this flake-specific construction reliably. We introduce 2D-FET-Bench V2, a benchmark of 128 layout tasks built from microscopy-derived flake contours, including hole-containing flakes and multi-flake tasks. Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. A deterministic verifier checks geometric and structural requirements, and a separate integrity check verifies that the supplied contours remain unchanged. Scripted reference layouts pass all 128 tasks, showing that every task is solvable. We evaluate...

items.title: Simplified Swarm Optimization for Surrogate-Assisted Reliability Design of Insulated-Gate Bipolar Transistor Power Modules Using an Open-Source Process Finite-Element Model
items.abstract: Process-induced warpage, ceramic stress and solder strain limit the reliability of insulated-gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) modules on direct-bonded copper (DBC) substrates. Surrogate-assisted design studies train regression models on finite-element analysis (FEA) databases, but rarely check the optimized designs against new FEA or report how surrogate error interacts with the optimizer. This paper builds and evaluates an open pipeline: an open-source process finite-element model, surrogates tuned by Simplified Swarm Optimization (SSO), multi-objective design search, FEA confirmation of selected designs and confirmation-driven infill. The model starts at the second reflow and reproduces measured warpage within 18.2%, 33.6% and 15.3% at the reflow, housing and molding stages without fitted parameters. On a balanced 60-design database, all stochastic tuners reach the same test accuracy, ou...

items.title: Theory of resonance Raman profiles in transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers: Interference effects due to inter-valley phonon scattering
items.abstract: The optical properties of monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) are strongly impacted by exciton-phonon coupling, especially inter-valley scattering in the case of tungsten-based materials. Together with strain-tunability of the energetic K-Q valley separation this material class therefore provides a platform for semiconductor optomechanics. Here we investigate the influence of inter-valley scattering and strain on resonance Raman scattering in monolayer TMDCs using a microscopic model based on an effective deformation potential coupling for the exciton-phonon interaction. Considering exemplarily the resonance Raman profile of the A$_1$-mode in hBN-encapsulated monolayer WSe$_2$, we find that inter-valley scattering between the electronic K- and Q-valley leads to destructive interference between a first order and a third order Raman process. As a result we obtain a suppressi...

items.title: Contact-Governed Macroscopic Signatures of Strain-Induced Valley Sorting in MoS$_2$ Field-Effect Transistors
items.abstract: Strain engineering is a leading route to control valley-selective transport in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides. Whether this quantum effect survives inside a fully contacted device remains an open question. Quantum transport models capture the underlying valley deflection but are limited to isolated nanoscale fragments, leaving it unclear if a full device registers strain-induced valley sorting in the bulk, at the contacts, or at all. Here, the quantum valley-deflection tensor of strained monolayer MoS$_2$ is embedded directly into a macroscopic Poisson-drift-diffusion model, extending this physics to a complete, contact-inclusive device. Applying this framework to a 300~nm monolayer MoS$_2$ transistor with a 3~nm HfO$_2$ gate dielectric at 77~K, under a localized 6.14~T pseudo-magnetic strain field, shows the resulting 63.6\% suppression of the ON-state current is not a bulk...

items.title: Optimal Photon Counting with Fast, Low Noise Astronomical Imagers
items.abstract: Measuring rapid astrophysical phenomena requires many short exposures, which suffer from repeated read noise. A variety of recent technologies are achieving sub-electron read noise, which enable rapid time-domain studies of faint sources. These data can be analyzed with traditional methods, but the ability to resolve individual electrons enables a new class of more precise, photon-counting techniques. We present a photon-counting method for sub-electron read noise detectors which delivers optimal statistical uncertainties. We focus on Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) detectors and demonstrate our method on optical data collected by CMOS instrument "proto-Lightspeed," recently commissioned at the Magellan Clay telescope at Las Campanas Observatory. The method can be applied to non-CMOS detectors as well, such as skipper CCDs and linear-mode avalanche photodiodes. The method...

items.abstract: The unprecedented computational scale of modern artificial intelligence depends on complex, multi-billion-transistor Systems-on-Chip, yet the workflows that verify these chips remain stubbornly manual. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have made rapid inroads into Electronic Design Automation (EDA), approximately 74.6% of existing studies target static Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code generation, leaving post-simulation verification and interactive waveform debugging largely untouched. We introduce Back-to-the-Future (BTTF), an end-to-end agentic framework that closes this infrastructural gap. BTTF distills massive, unstructured simulation dumps into a normalized relational SQLite database and couples it with a collaborative multi-agent orchestration engine that translates natural-language verification queries into schema-aware SQL while correlating signal anomalies with versioned...

items.title: Interplay between Excitability and Noise in Analog Spiking Neurons
items.abstract: A spiking neuron is a dynamical system exhibiting a limit cycle (a spike) when subject to sufficiently excitatory input. Famous neuroscience experiments by Bryant and Segundo as well as Mainen and Sejnowski revealed that the spike times of some biological neurons are more reliable when subject to time-varying stimuli compared to constant ones. Provided with an industrial physics-based transient noise SPICE simulation framework compatible with foundry transistor compact models, we have demonstrated similar behaviours for a CMOS analog spiking neuron designed for neuromorphic computing hardware platforms. Under constant excitation current, the neuron operates in oscillatory regime and the empirical periods (interspike intervals) suffer from accumulated phase noise (jitter) during successive cycles, mainly due to the thermal noise of transistors. A programmable quantum photonic platform integrating coherent emitters
items.abstract: Photonic quantum technologies require the integration of high-quality quantum light sources with programmable photonic circuitry to enable on-chip quantum information processing. Semiconductor quantum dots have emerged as a leading platform for quantum light generation, yet their monolithic integration with cryogenic-compatible, programmable photonic circuitry remains challenging. Here we demonstrate a programmable quantum photonic platform that enables simultaneous control of highly coherent quantum dot-based single photon emitters and reconfigurable optical elements at cryogenic temperatures. System-level integration enables individual electrical and optical addressing of active components on a single chip, allowing their concurrent operation while preserving coherent non-classical light emission. We demonstrate multiple quantum-photonic functionalities, including pure single-photon ge...

Acceleration of Data Analytics on Heterogeneous Supercloud Systems
items.abstract: Heterogeneous Supercloud systems are transforming data analytics by enabling scalable and efficient task distribution across diverse resources. This paper presents computational models and performance estimation techniques tailored for accelerating Dense Cholesky (CH) Decomposition and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)-based analytics on Heterogeneous Superclouds. Our ReDSEa tool-chain automates mapping, load balancing, scheduling, parallelism, and computation overlap. Implemented on a heterogeneous system with a Huawei Kunpeng 920 ARM CPU and an Ascend 910 AI accelerator, our LLVM compiler tool-chain employs novel performance models for recursive, iterative, and blocked computations, achieving up to 17x speedup for CH and 88x for SVD over fully optimized 48-core CPU implementations.

Four modulators are considered an InP electro absorption modulator, a LiNbO3 dual drive Mach Zehnder modulator, a dual parallel Mach Zehnder modulator and a silicon carrier depletion modulator

items.title: Time frequency distributions of optical sources (I): directly modulated semiconductor lasers
items.abstract: We develop a time frequency framework for the dynamics of directly modulated semiconductor lasers in which the optical field obtained from the singlemode rate equations is represented by distributions of Cohen class. Closed form small signal solutions are derived for RC filtered square current pulses and for sinusoidal modulation, including the exact chirp to power ratio with gain compression and spontaneous emission and a line expansion of the Wigner distribution of the sinusoidally modulated field. Kernels satisfying two known conditions return the laser chirp as the first conditional moment.

items.abstract: Process control of advanced semiconductor nodes is not only pushing the limits of metrology equipment requirements in terms of resolution and throughput but also in terms of the richness of data to be extracted to enable engineers to finetune the process steps for increased yield. Similarly, with the increase in stochastic defects in the EUV era, detection of defects at the nm scale requires the identification of features captured in low resolution to meet the throughput requirements of HVM fabs, which can again lead to custom algorithm development. items.title: Image resolution enhancement for advanced semiconductor nodes
items.abstract: Advanced semiconductor nodes are pushing the limits of feature sizes and require metrology with sub-nm resolution without compromising on the throughput as needed for in-line process control. Recently, high-throughput scanning probe microscopy (SPM) based metrology and inspection tools capable of meeting these needs have been introduced to the market and qualified for use in HVM. While innovative measurement methods and tool architecture have allowed for a leap of improvement in throughput, the next step in further reducing imaging time can be obtained through the application of machine learning for enhancing the resolution of measured images for extraction of relevant parameters. In this work, we provide the general framework under which a neural network-based resolution enhancer is designed and used for SPM images. items.title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
items.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. items.title: Hall conductance of dilute electrolytes from odd stochastic density functional theory
items.abstract: Electrolytes under an external magnetic field exhibit a Hall conductivity, much like metals and semiconductors. However, existing theories fail to quantitatively account for their measured Hall conductivities. To make progress toward such a theory, we develop a stochastic density functional framework for electrolytes in a magnetic field. items.title: Inverse-Designed High-Q/V Silicon Nitride Photonic Crystal Cavities for Second- and Third-Harmonic Generation
items.abstract: SiN photonic crystal (PhC) cavities are promising platforms for nonlinear and quantum photonics because of their wide transparency window, CMOS compatibility, and negligible two-photon absorption. However, realizing high-Q/V cavities remains challenging because of the relatively low refractive index of SiN. Here, we employ inverse design to optimize a two-dimensional SiN PhC cavity and experimentally demonstrate a quality factor of approximately 80,000, the highest reported for a near-stoichiometric SiN 2D PhC cavity. Furthermore, both second- and third-harmonic generation are observed from the same cavity, providing experimental evidence of strong optical confinement and large Q/V. Our results establish inverse-designed SiN PhC cavities as a promising platform for nonlinear photonics and future heterogeneous integrated photonic devices.

items.title: Magnetic enhancement and Hall conductivity of excitonic insulators in a Gross--Neveu type model
items.abstract: We study the effects of a perpendicular magnetic field on the excitonic insulator (EI) phase in the semiconductor regime using an extended planar four-Fermi model. Within the large-$N$ approximation, we determine the coupled scalar and excitonic condensates at finite temperature, chemical potential, and magnetic field. The field enhances the EI condensate and raises its critical temperature, providing an excitonic realization of magnetic catalysis, while the scalar condensate remains constant throughout the EI phase. By contrast, the critical chemical potential depends nonmonotonically on the field because of the successive occupation of Landau levels. The magnetic field also shifts the mean-field tricritical point and enlarges the first-order region of the temperature--chemical-potential phase diagram. We further analyze the Hall conductivity and find that increasing the field reduces t...

items.title: Approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser for reducing energy consumption
items.abstract: Photonic reservoir computing is a promising physical machine-learning approach for time-series prediction. Quantization of the reservoir response signal is an important consideration in the implementation of photonic reservoir computing, and the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency need to be optimized to achieve high prediction performance and low energy consumption. However, few studies have investigated the effects of the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency on both prediction performance and energy consumption. In this study, we introduce the concept of approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser by quantizing the reservoir node states and output weights. We numerically evaluate the performance of a chaotic time-series prediction task and estimate the energy consumption per sample using a component-level model. By optimizing the number of qu...

items.title: Graph-Based Kirchhoff Modeling of Non-Ohmic Electron Transport in Self-Assembled Nanonecklace Networks
items.abstract: Gold nanonecklace networks exhibit non-Ohmic current--voltage I-V characteristics with a sharp conduction threshold, making them promising for sensing and transistor-like devices. However, their conduction has been understood largely empirically, because experiments cannot see how conduction evolves inside the network. To address this, we develop a graph-based Kirchhoff modeling framework that resolves these internal processes, tracking the potential and current of every junction. Although every active element conducts linearly, the model reproduces the non-Ohmic response $I \propto (V-V_T)^ζ$. It also captures the experimentally observed effects of junction properties, network density, and voids, which lends confidence to its predicted internal states. These states show that the non-Ohmic response emerges from voltage-driven percolation. Conduction is governed by how junctions are conne...

items.title: Complex frequency-dependent quadrature squeezing in semiconductor lasers
items.abstract: We present a comprehensive study of quadrature squeezing in a quantum well laser based on a fully quantum Langevin approach. We compute the frequency-resolved squeezing map of the laser field and identify optimal squeezing curves, revealing, for the first time to our knowledge, both frequency-dependent squeezing and complex or hidden squeezing in a semiconductor laser. We further analyse the role of the linewidth enhancement factor (alpha-factor) in the emergence of these features. Our results establish semiconductor lasers as a platform for the generation of non-classical light and open new perspectives for their application in quantum communication and sensing.

items.title: Electron state tomography from quasiparticle interference maps
items.abstract: Characterizing electronic band structures requires precise knowledge of wave functions and their quantum geometry. Here, we introduce a tomography method to reconstruct the density matrix of electron states from quasiparticle interference maps around single impurities. We consider two-orbital models on a honeycomb lattice, relevant to graphene heterostructures and direct-gap semiconductors. For on-site impurities, backscattering between time-reversed states directly maps the density matrix populations and coherences into distinct orbital contributions in the interference map. While local probes usually lack orbital resolution, these orbital contributions transform under distinct symmetry group representations and can thus be disentangled to reveal the density matrix and quantum geometric tensor of the scattering states. This establishes impurities as tomographic probes for band structure...

items.title: Nanoscopic Multiplexing Optical Data Storage via Chip Fabrication
items.abstract: The accelerating growth of global data demands storage technologies combining high capacity, long lifetime and low energy consumption. Optical storage is attractive for archival applications, but conventional optical writing is constrained by diffraction-limited resolution and scalability, while thermal accumulation limits high-speed writing. Here we shift optical data writing from a serial optical process to a fabrication-defined process, in which lithographic masks govern where material modification occurs. Using patterned resist masks and ion implantation, we create fluorescent information voxels with nanoscale control over millimeter-scale areas. The platform supports multilevel and multidimensional encoding by independently encoding information in fluorescence intensity and wavelength. A machine-learning-assisted super-resolution reconstruction protocol is developed to recover infor...

items.title: Anharmonic Quantum Transport Analysis of Thermal Transport Anomalies in Ultrathin Silicon Nanowires
items.abstract: Thermal transport in low-dimensional semiconductors is important for nanoelectronics, quantum devices, and thermoelectrics. Recent molecular dynamics (MD) studies reveal a nonmonotonic diameter dependence of thermal conductivity in ultrathin silicon nanowires (NWs), but classical MD is limited at low temperatures and under strong confinement. Here, we investigate this anomaly using anharmonic non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) simulations combined with density functional theory-trained neuroevolution potentials. All transport results are expressed as effective thermal conductivities ($κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$) for NW devices with a finite channel length of $L=10$ nm. At 300 K, $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$ decreases with diameter to minima at 6.24 and 5.50 nm for [001]- and [110]-oriented NWs, respectively. At 10 K, the corresponding minima occur at 7.33 and 5.50 nm. items.title: Predictive Software Scheduling as an Early-Warning Hint Layer for Optical Engine Thermal Drift in Heterogeneous SoIC Packaging
items.abstract: As semiconductor scaling approaches the A16 / 2 nm node, the integration of co-packaged optics (CPO) through TSMC's Compact Universal Photonic Engine (COUPE) architecture introduces critical thermal-optical coupling challenges. Micro-ring resonators embedded in the Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) layer are highly sensitive to temperature, with a wafer-level center wavelength deviation of merely +/-1.7 nm across a 300 mm wafer representing the platform's manufacturing control limit. To address this, we propose XRM-SSD V24, a physics-aware scheduling layer that models inference-load density 20-50 ms before execution and issues early-warning hints to the COUPE bias-control firmware, enabling pre-emptive thermal compensation. Simulation-based validation on a software emulation platform (physical characterization pending TSMC tape-out) over 90,000 inference steps yields a simulator-internal...

items.title: Speed Kills: Exploring Confused Deputy Attacks Through Edge AI Accelerators
items.abstract: AI Accelerators (AIAs) are specialized hardware, such as Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), that enable optimal and efficient execution of AI applications and on-device inference. The growing demand for AI applications has led to the widespread adoption of AIAs on edge and embedded devices. Unlike applications, AIAs are not bound by Operating System (OS) restrictions and have limited visibility into Application Processor (AP) security mechanisms (e.g., kernel versus application memory and process isolation). This semantic gap can lead to confused deputy vulnerabilities, where an AIA can be tricked by a malicious application into performing privileged operations on its behalf. In this paper, we conduct the first in-depth study of Confused Deputy Attacks (CDAs) using AIAs. We design DeputyHunt, a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to extract CDA-relevant information for a given AIA...

items.title: Energy Consumption in Next Generation Radio Access Networks
items.abstract: Historically, in macro-cell-based networks, the radio access network (RAN) portion accounts for the largest share of energy consumption in mobile networks. With greater densification, the transition to small cells and increased virtualization of the radio processing functions, the relative energy use of the different network segments is changing. At the same time, open radio access networks (O-RAN) have emerged as a promising approach to support this evolution through open interfaces that enable a multi-vendor environment, support for hierarchical intelligent controls, and simplified, cost-effective radio units that facilitate large-scale deployments. This paper examines the impact of these changes on energy consumption in next-generation RAN architectures through transaction-based energy models. Transaction-based network energy models were developed in 2009 to understand the evolution o...

items.title: Joint Architecture-Token-Bitwidth Multi-Axis Optimization of Vision Transformers for Semiconductor IC Packaging
items.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance in visual recognition, yet their deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments remains limited. The main challenges are their high computational cost, memory requirements, and energy consumption. While individual efficiency techniques such as neural architecture search (NAS), token compression, and low-precision inference have been extensively studied, most prior work targets only a single optimization axis, limiting overall deployment gains while preserving accuracy. In this paper, we present one of the first holistic frameworks that jointly optimizes three complementary axes: architecture, token, and bit-width. Specifically, the framework identifies compact backbones via Neural Architecture Search (AutoFormer), reduces information processing via token merging (ToMe), and accelerates per-operation execution via fp1...

items.title: Proximitized Topological Insulator Charge Island Fabricated via In Situ Multi-Angle Stencil Lithography
items.abstract: Hybrid superconductor-topological insulator (TI) nanostructures constitute a promising material platform for exploring proximity-induced superconductivity in systems with topologically protected surface states. A key obstacle has been the realization of clean and well-controlled superconductor-TI interfaces, as TI surfaces rapidly degrade under ambient conditions. Here, we introduce a fully in situ, multi-angle stencil lithography technique that enables the fabrication of proximitized charge islands in TIs. The approach combines selective area growth of (Bi,Sb)$_2$Te$_3$ nanoribbons with angle-controlled deposition of diffusion barriers, superconducting Al, and ultrathin oxide tunnel barriers, allowing scalable fabrication of hybrid nanostructures without post-growth processing.
